brief:
Zeteo reported that content creator Hasan Piker has expressed frustration with mainstream media outlets, claiming they decline to interview him despite his large following. Piker identified specific shows he would be willing to appear on, signaling openness to engagement with established broadcasting platforms if they extended invitations.

The interview surfaced as Piker discussed his relationship with traditional news media and the barriers he faces in reaching mainstream audiences through conventional channels. Zeteo's reporting also examined BBC editorial decisions surrounding Gaza coverage, with critics arguing the broadcaster has censored or restricted discussion of genocide-related topics on air and online.
dek: The streamer tells Zeteo which shows he’d love to go on – if they’d just ask. Plus, the latest BBC censorship on the genocide in Gaza.
title: Streamer Hasan Piker says major outlets ignore interview requests
